## CLAUDE.md

# Authority OS — Project Context

## What This Is
Multi-tenant entity visibility operating system for agencies. Combines SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and social platform optimization into one app.

## PRD
Full product requirements document: `../PRD.md` (26 sections, complete data model, build phases, platform methods)

## Tech Stack
- Next.js 16 (App Router, no src/ directory)
- Supabase Postgres (shared project: ivhfuhxorppptyuofbgq)
- Supabase Auth + RLS for multi-tenancy (implemented)
- Tailwind CSS v4
- Vercel deployment
- All tables prefixed with `aos_`

## Database Tables (Phase 1)
- aos_workspaces, aos_workspace_members
- aos_entities, aos_entity_aliases, aos_entity_socials, aos_entity_topics, aos_entity_competitors, aos_entity_offers, aos_entity_proof, aos_entity_locations
- aos_audits, aos_audit_findings, aos_recommendations, aos_crawled_pages

## Multi-Tenancy (PRD-002)
- RLS enabled on all 14 aos_* tables (except aos_workspace_members used in policy subqueries)
- WorkspaceContext provider in dashboard layout with localStorage persistence
- WorkspaceSwitcher dropdown in sidebar
- Invite flow: POST /api/workspaces/[id]/invite → /invite/[token] acceptance page
- Role-based permissions: owner > admin > member > viewer (lib/permissions.ts)
- All API routes verify auth via createSupabaseServer() + workspace membership
- Team management at /settings/team
- Workspace settings at /settings (name, slug, delete)

## Default Workspace
ID: `00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001` (slug: "default")
Fallback when no workspaces are found for the user.

## Key Commands
```bash
npm run dev          # Start dev server (port 3000)
npm run build        # Production build
npx vercel --yes --prod  # Deploy
```

## Audit Engine
The audit engine crawls a website and scores 6 categories:
- Entity Clarity (20%) — name consistency, about page, OG tags
- Schema Markup (20%) — JSON-LD presence,

offers.offer_copy: For SEO specialists at agencies who seek integrated tools but find themselves using disparate software, we offer an all-in-one platform combining SEO, GEO, AEO, and social optimization so they can achieve seamless operations without inefficiencies.

For small business digital marketers who need effective online optimization but face limited resources, we provide cost-effective SEO and social tools so they can compete with larger entities without stretching budgets.

offers_and_verdict.next_action: Ship 3 landing pages for the top anchor phrases and allocate $75 each for Google Search ads to validate interest and fine-tune messaging.
offers_and_verdict.reasoning: The search demand indicates that there is tangible interest in SEO tools, but specifically for roles that manage multiple clients or operate in niche contexts like small businesses. Buyer urgency isn’t very high, suggesting a need for strong initial offers to capture interest more decisively. Although buyers seem willing to pay, there is a risk around standing out within a crowded market of SEO tools. MVP feasibility presents challenges but validating concept interest will signal better product-market fit scenarios and guide further development.
